fields.what_it_is: CERVICAL SPINE TRUSS SYSTEM™ – ANCHOR FIXATION INTERBODY FUSION DEVICE. CSTS-SA with Anchor Fixation has an Advanced Structural Design that incorporates 4WEB Medical’s proprietary Truss Implant Technology™. Under normal loading conditions the struts in the truss implant transfer strain to adjacent cellular material which stimulates a mechanobiologic response. Novel Truss Implant TechnologyTM provides a Snow Shoe Interface that distributes load across the endplate minimizing point loading and reducing the risk of subsidence.* Hierarchical surface roughness spans from the macro to nano scale. These surface features have been shown to stimulate increased gene expression of certain osteogenic markers when compared to other interbody surfaces and materials.1 Open architecture design allows for greater graft volume and bone growth throughout the entire construct.* Pre-assembled anchor Nail Rail TechnologyTM. Zero-profile. Single-step locking mechanism. Easier fixation. deployment system for ease of use. to ensure proper anchor trajectory for difficult anatomy.
